label: A judgment of one diagnosis by Claude as a judge (klaxon.judge): a model's, not a rule's or a person's. It saw the right answer and the remedy of the system the diagnosis was made on, and the whole diagnosis; never which model wrote it, nor the rule's verdict. A recorded response, in judge-recording.jsonl.

right_answer.cause: a deploy of the ledger consumer without its dedupe (LEDGER_HANDLER=naive): every webhook the provider sends again, after an acknowledgement it never got, is booked a second time
right_answer.remedy: roll the ledger consumer back to the idempotent handler, then repair each double posting with a reversal (a write, so it needs approval)

judgment.why: It names the 07:07:44 ledger-consumer deploy with LEDGER_HANDLER=naive, which skips event_id dedupe, so the provider's resent evt_000281 was booked twice. Its fix rolls the consumer back and reverses the duplicate transaction 282.
